facts.claim: The town has 326 houses and 1,213 residents, including 360 Christians, 388 Muslims, and 465 Hindus.
facts.quote: It contains now 326 houses, mostly tiled, and a population of 1,213 souls, of whom 360 are Christians, 388 Mussulmans and 465 Hindus.

facts.claim: The town holds a market every Monday, which is why it is called Fraserpet.
facts.quote: Every Monday there is market, hence the name of the place.

facts.claim: The town has a Roman Catholic Church, a shrine to Ganapati with a public well, an Anglo-Vernacular School, a native rest-house with a tank, a government wood-yard, and European bungalows.
facts.quote: The town can boast of a Roman Catholic Church, a newly built shrine, dedicated to Ganapati, with a very useful public well in front of it, an Anglo-Vernacular School, a native rest-house with a tank and a Government wood-yard, besides the European bangalows.
